translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

content: Alat a Nasaret lomǝtahun aYesu
AYesu eriŋ naut enan, evi Nasaret, naut a im san, ale ahai susur san gail lohusuri.

Len nǝSappat etub̃at hǝn nap̃usanan len naim nab̃onb̃onan ale isob̃ur lotosǝsǝloŋ lup̃aŋ luke, “Ategai ilav natgalenan tokele a be? Namitisau egai hǝn nǝmauran tonor gai tokade egǝm len naut a be? Igol mabe hǝn namerikel lotomaienan?
Be ategai inau ke tovi ase? Gai evi nǝvanuan na-um-im-an ŋai, anatun aMeri, aṽan aJemes, aJoses, aJutas mai aSimon. Aṽavinen gail lutoh gegai!” Ale len nǝlol sasa salito lomǝtahuni.

Ale aYesu ikel mai galit ke, “Ahai kelkel ur, nǝvanuan gail loputsani len nǝnauan salito len naut p̃isi, be len naut a im san, len amahean gail mai len nǝbathudud san, natsua, lǝsaputsani, lomǝtahuni.”
Edǝdas b̃igol namerikel ideh len naut enan, be eriŋ navǝlan len nǝvanuan evis ŋai lotomǝsah ei ale lumaur.
Ale ip̃aŋ husur nadǝlomian salit tob̃uer. AYesu esǝvat ahai susur lotovi 12 hǝn lǝb̃eum m̃osi (Mat 10.5-15; Luk 9.1-6) Beti aYesu iyar husur navile ṽisusua, ep̃usan.
Ale ekis b̃onb̃on hǝn ahai susur san gail ale etub̃at sǝvat galit lorururu van. Ale ilav mai galito nǝdaŋan hǝn na-il-a-m̃o-an hǝn lǝb̃ehut nanunun nǝmargobut gail.
Ale ikele hǝn galit ke, “Samtilav natideh len nǝvanan samito, samtilav nabǝta, samtitariv nǝhad sǝsǝŋon, samtilav nǝvat ideh len nǝhau tutuṽ samit gail. Mitipat nǝhai tǝbatehw ŋai.
Mǝtevǝlas naributbut be samtitariv nahurabat gǝgel.”
Ale ikel mai galit ke, “Naim ideh mǝtb̃eb̃is lan, mititoh ei vǝbar mǝtb̃eriŋ naut enan.

Len naut ideh lǝsahǝhaṽur hǝn mǝtb̃itoh lan, lǝsasǝsǝloŋ hǝn gamito, mǝteriŋ naut enan, dardar hǝn nariemito hǝn nǝmasiav b̃imakuv dan gǝlaru. Natenan tevi hǝn b̃imasil hǝn galit ei ke aGot sahǝhaṽur hǝn galito.”
Imaienan, luvan. Lukel uri ke nǝvanuan gail limaspair dan nǝsaan salito.
Lohut natǝmat isob̃ur, ale lovǝhas nǝvanuan isob̃ur lotomǝsah hǝn naoil naoliv, ale lumaur.
Nǝmatan siJon Baptais
AHerot Antipas, aKiŋ esǝsǝloŋ hǝn nakelean husur aYesu, bathut nǝvanuan gail p̃isi lolǝboi nahǝsan.
Galevis luke “Atenan evi Jon Baptais tole mǝhat dan nǝmatan. Imagenan elǝboi b̃igol namerikel gail.”
Galevis am luke, “Gai evi Elijah.” Galevis tile am luke, “Ahai kelkel ur bolai, esum̃an ahai kelkel ur gail ta sutuai.”
Nǝboŋ aHerot tosǝsǝloŋ hǝn natgalenan, ike, “AJon, gai notota kotov nǝkadun, ile mǝhat dan nǝmatan! Imaur tǝlmam!”

Evi aHerot enan tokel mai nasoltia gail ke litah gat aJon, baŋisi, ale riŋi len naim bǝbaŋis. Igol tomaienan sil abareab siHerot, aHerotias. Alitenan evi asoan aFilip, be aHerot aṽan aFilip esǝhar kuvi ale ilah maii.
AHerot eriŋ aJon len naim bǝbaŋis husur aJon ikel mai aHerot ke, “Len nalo, sanor hǝn gǝb̃esǝhar asoan aṽam̃.”
Ŋa aHerotias, nǝlon epǝŋas aJon, elǝŋon ke tigol timat be edǝdasi,

husur aHerot emǝtahw len aJon, ike aJon titoh maienan ŋai. Elǝboii ke aJon tovi vanuan tonor, tovoi buni. Nǝboŋ aHerot tosǝsǝloŋ hǝn aJon, edidimair hǝni; be naut kǝmas natenan, elǝmas b̃esǝsǝloŋ hǝn aJon.

Imaienan van van, be boŋ sua aHerotias isab̃ nap̃isal sua. Len nab̃iltiboŋ hǝn nǝpasian siHerot, aHerot igol nǝhanan m̃os nab̃iltivanuan gail lototah maii, nakomada gail mai nǝvanuan totibau gail len naut a Kalili. AHerotias ikab hǝn nǝboŋ enan husur elǝboi b̃igol aJon b̃imat.
Nǝboŋ anatvavin aHerotias tob̃is ale tosav, aHerot mai alat lotohan maii ei lohǝhaṽur masuṽ hǝni. Ale aKiŋ ikel mai alitenan ke, “Us ginau hǝn natideh gotolǝŋoni ale dereh nilavi mai gaiug.”
Ale ita gat na-kel-gati-an sua len nahǝsan ke, “Natideh gǝb̃eusi hǝn ginau, dereh nilavi mai gaiug, naut kǝmas b̃evi nahudhut nǝtan notovi kiŋ lan.”
Alitenan evivile, eus anan ke, “Neus nǝsa?” Anan ike, “Geus nǝkadun aJon Baptais.”
Vǝha-sua ŋai natǝbarehreh esǝtab̃ul van hǝn aKiŋ, ike, “Nolǝŋon nǝkadun aJon Baptais. Nolǝŋoni len nasiloh sua. Nolǝŋoni gag ŋai!”
Nǝboŋ tokǝmaienan igol aKiŋ nǝlon isa, be husur tota gat na-kel-gati-an san len nahǝsan, ale husur tokele len nǝhon alat lotohan maii, inau ke naut kǝmas tomǝtahuni, timasgol nǝsa aliten tousi hǝni.
Ŋa vǝha-sua ŋai esǝvat nasoltia nǝ-tata-vanuan-an van hǝn naim bǝbaŋis hǝn b̃ita kotov nǝkadun aJon ale pati gǝmai. Ale nasoltia ivan, ita kotov nǝkadun aJon len naim bǝbaŋis.
Ipat nǝkadun aJon len nasiloh, lavi mai natǝbarehreh. Ale natǝbarehreh ilavi mai anan.
Nǝboŋ ahai susur siJon gail lotosǝsǝloŋ hǝni ke tomat, logǝm pat niben van, tavuni len nab̃ur nǝmatan.
AYesu evǝŋan alalum̃an lotovi 5,000
Nǝboŋ ahai pispisul gail lototǝlmam len nǝyaran salito, lub̃on mai aYesu hǝn lǝb̃ikel maii hǝn natit p̃isi lotogole mai lotop̃usan hǝni.
Nǝvanuan isob̃ur logǝmai, isob̃ur luvan gol aYesu galito lǝsǝkad namityal ideh hǝn lǝb̃ihan. Imaienan aYesu ike, “Datevi tut ideh hǝn datb̃itoh sǝb̃odato ale ŋavŋav kǝkereh.”
Ŋa lusah len nab̃ot sǝb̃olito, loriŋ naut enan, lovi lan naut tob̃ǝb̃esw.
Wake isob̃ur loris lotovan ale lolǝboi naut lǝb̃evi lan. Ale nǝvanuan isob̃ur len navile gail lugam vi lan naut en tob̃ǝb̃esw ale lubari a m̃o.

Nǝboŋ aYesu galit lotobar naut enan, lotomariŋ dan nab̃ot, aYesu eris nab̃iltiluṽoh ale nǝlon itaŋis galito husur lohum nasipsip gail lotopar vanuan hǝn b̃ekǝtkǝta tǝban galito. Ale etub̃at ṽusan galit hǝn natit isob̃ur.
Namityal ipair tia ale ahai susur san gail logǝm hǝni luke, “Naut egai ipat a tut dan navile gail ale namityal ivan p̃isi tia.
Sǝvat galit van, hǝn lǝb̃evi lan naim ṽisusua marireu mai navile gail lotodar vis naut egai, hǝn lǝb̃ep̃ur hanian halit hǝn lǝb̃ihani.”
Ris tosor var galit ke, “Gamit m̃au mitilav nǝhanian mai galito!” Ale lukel maii ke, “Hǝn namtb̃eṽur nǝhanian hilategai nǝvat han dereh tevi hǝn nap̃urp̃uran hǝn nahǝbati tomǝlevtor. Namtodǝdasi!”
Ale aYesu eus galit ke, “Mǝtukad nabǝta evis? Mitia us kitevi.” Nǝboŋ lototǝlmam lukel uri ke, “Nabǝta erim mai naieh eru.”
Beti aYesu ikele hǝn galit ke letuan naluṽoh lebǝtah pǝpehw len naliol tokǝsan.
Ale nǝvanuan lotovi 50 o lotovi 100 lobǝtah b̃onb̃on van vǝbar galit p̃isi lobǝtah.

AYesu ilav nabǝta torim mai naieh toru, ekǝta vi lan nǝmav, ikel nasipaan hǝn gail ale eb̃ur nabǝta. Ilav gail mai ahai susur san gail hǝn lǝb̃epǝpehuni. Ale epǝpehun naieh eru enan am van hǝn nǝvanuan gail p̃isi.
Ale galit p̃isi luhan, luhanukub.
Naluṽoh lotohan tonoŋ, ahai susur losǝŋon nahudhubǝta mai nahudhuieh lotopat vagol nǝhad lotovi 12 lopul.
Len nǝboŋ enan alalum̃an lotohan lovi 5,000.
AYesu iyar len nǝp̃on nǝwai
Nǝboŋ nǝhanan tonoŋ, vǝha-sua ŋai aYesu igol ahai susur sǝb̃olit lusah len nab̃ot, il a m̃o, hǝn lǝb̃igam vi Petsaita, tarhǝb̃iltiwai Kalili. Ale aYesu esǝvat naluṽoh luvan.
Tosudǝlam̃ galit tonoŋ, etǝṽehuh len naṽehuh hǝn b̃isor mai aGot.
Nǝboŋ naut togomgom, nab̃ot ipat rivuh len nab̃iltiwai, ale aYesu itoh sǝb̃on a ut.
Eris lotomab̃it hǝn nǝvarusan husur nab̃ot isoh b̃ur nǝlan. Len nadudulan som̃ilan naut sǝlan sal, aYesu egǝm hǝn galito, iyar len nǝp̃on nab̃iltiwai. Ike tiṽot tǝban galito,
be nǝboŋ lotoris toyar len nǝp̃on nab̃iltiwai, lunau ke tovi nanunun sua. Lukai,
husur nǝboŋ lotorisi galit p̃isi lom̃inm̃inikot. Be vǝha-sua ŋai aYesu ikel mai galit ke, “Samtemǝtahw. Ginau bogai. Mitikad na-il-b̃uri-an.”
Ŋa isah len nab̃ot mai galito ale nǝlan evi pan, idar buni. Ahai susur gail lumaŋmaŋ vǝsa,
husur lǝsalǝboi sal namilen namerikel aYesu togole husur nabǝta gail, bathut nǝkadulit iṽonṽon.
AYesu igol galit lotomǝsah a Kennesaret lumaur
Nǝboŋ lotogam tukot len nab̃iltiwai, luvahut a Kennesaret ale lokir ei.
Lumariŋ dan nab̃ot, vǝha-sua ŋai nǝvanuan gail len naut enan lokǝta lǝboii.
Lugam tutur len naut kavkav enan, ale naut lotosǝsǝloŋ hǝni ke aYesu totoh lan, lupat alat lotomǝsah van hǝni len namilelit gail.

Len naut p̃isi aYesu tovi lan, len navile, len nab̃iltivile, len nǝmarireu, loriŋ alaten lotomǝsah lupat len naut nǝmaket. Loŋiri ke tidam̃ hǝn lǝb̃ibar nasum̃arhǝt nahurabat san. Ale galit p̃isi lotobari lumaur.

footnotes.text: 6.11 Nǝboŋ naJu gail lotoyaryar len naut savi salito, ludardar hǝn naributbut mai nahurabat salito hǝn nǝmasiav b̃imakuv dan gail. Lugol naten husur lotonau ke alat lǝsavi Ju mai naut salit gail lob̃iŋb̃iŋal. Gegai aYesu ikel mai ahai susur san gail ke ligol husur naṽide enan hǝn b̃imasil hǝn naJu gail lotomǝtahun lǝb̃ipair dan nǝsaan salit gail ke len nabunusian siGot galit lob̃iŋb̃iŋal ale dereh lipanis.
6.14 Nǝboŋ toke aHerot len naut egai, evi aHerot Antipas tovi anatun aHerot toyalyal. AHerot toyalyal ike aYesu timat nǝboŋ tokǝkereh ŋai.
6.37 Len nasoruan ta Kris ike natenarius tovi 200, nǝvat tomaienan elǝboi b̃eṽur nauman hǝn nǝvanuan hǝn nahǝbati tomǝlevtor.
